notes: CAN 2.0 is a wire-level protocol; no analog reference / trim / calibration loop. Oscillator tolerance is a system-integration concern (0.5 % baseline; 1.5 % with the Section 9 upwards-compatible modifications). Per-segment bit-timing programming (PROP_SEG / PHASE_SEG1 / SJW) substitutes for any calibration loop at the protocol level.
